records.query: Apple 最近有什麼跟 Siri 有關的法律訴訟或和解消息？
records.answer:
Apple 最近因「增強版 Siri」功能未實際推出而面臨訴訟，並同意以最高 $95（每部 iPhone）向受影響的約 3,700 萬名 iPhone 15/16 用戶支付最高 2.5 億美元（$250 million） 的和解金【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

- 訴訟指控 Apple 在行銷「Enhanced Siri features」時誤導消費者，使其基於未實現的 AI 功能購買 iPhone 15 Pro、iPhone 15 Pro Max 或 iPhone 16，購買期間為 2024 年 6 月 10 日至 2025 年 3 月 29 日【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 和解方案規定，每部符合條件的 iPhone 初始賠償金為 $25，最終金額最高不超過 $95，總和解金額上限為 2.5 億美元（$250 million）【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- Apple 表示已解決此事，以便專注於「提供最創新的產品與服務」【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 合格用戶將透過電子郵件或郵寄方式收到索賠通知，並可於未來數週內於專屬網站查詢詳情【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. Depending on how many claims are submitted and other determining factors, the final payment may increase or decrease, but it will not exceed $95 per device, according to the court filing
How do I file a claim? Claim filing details are not released yet. Clarkson Law Firm said on its
website
that a settlement website with more details will be available in "a few weeks."
According to the court filing, the website "will include all necessary information to learn about the settlement" and a number consumers can call with questions. Edited by

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: NVIDIA 最近跟 IREN 之間有什麼合作的新聞？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最近與 IREN 簽下了 **34 億美元的五年 AI Cloud 合約**，同時提供 **最高 21 億美元的投資權利**，雙方將在 IREN 全球資料中心部署數十萬顆 GPU，以加速 AI 基礎設施建置【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。

- 合約內容：IREN 獲得與 NVIDIA 的 5 GW NVIDIA‑aligned AI 基礎設施合作，合約金額 34 億美元，隨 GPU 部署而逐步解鎖，全部部署 600,000 顆 GPU 後投資權利才會完全生效【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 投資權利：NVIDIA 可在五年內以每股 70 美元的價格購買最多 0.3 億（30 百萬）普通股，若全部行使，最高可帶來 21 億美元的潛在投資【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 2026 年建設藍圖：IREN 計畫在 2026 年完成 480 MW AI Cloud 容量，部署約 150,000 顆 GPU，目標在 2026 年底前將年度經常性收入（ARR）提升至 37 億美元（目前已達 31 億美元）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 合約相關收入：在 34 億美元的 NVIDIA 合約中，已經與之掛鉤的 ARR 約為 7 億美元【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 2027 年擴張：計畫將 AI Cloud 容量擴大至 1,210 MW，並持續建設 730 MW（其中約 450 MW 於 Childress、280 MW 於 Sweetwater）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 市場反應：公告後 IREN 股價在盤後跳漲 27%，最高觸及 72.28 美元，收盤後回落至 69.45 美元，仍較前收盤上漲超過 21%【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  

以上資訊皆來自 2026 年 5 月的新聞稿與財報說明，概括了 NVIDIA 與 IREN 近期合作的主要條款、部署計畫與市場影響。

Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. "H200s are licensed to sell to China.

"My sense is that over time the market will open," added Huang, CEO of Nvidia -- the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware. Trump said in December he had reached an agreement with Xi to ease the restrictions on H200 chips, a move some US lawmakers have warned could help the Chinese military. Nvidia's most top-of-the-range offerings, the Blackwell and forthcoming Rubin series, remain banned for sale in China. Xi told a delegation of US business executives on Thursday that China would "open wider" to the world.

records.query: 最近有哪些關於 Meta 的利多分析與 AI 投資消息？
records.answer:

- Meta 在 2026 年上半年度的投資活動中，已使用 **491.1 億美元** 購置伺服器、資料中心與網路基礎設施，另有 **315.6 億美元** 的可交易證券淨購買，顯示公司正大幅擴張 AI 所需的硬體與資金配置【META_10Q_202606.html, chunk #110】。  
- 公司預計 2026 年的資本支出將介於 **1300 億至 1450 億美元**，主要用於支援 AI 事業與核心業務【META_10Q_2026.html, chunk #110】。  
- 在同一期間，Meta 表示 **87%** 的總成本與費用屬於「前端支出 (FoA)」，其中包括與 AI 相關的員工、資料中心與技術基礎設施支出，並持續提升第三方雲端容量、伺服器與資料中心投資，以推動生成式 AI 與超級智慧等計畫【META_10Q_202606.html, chunk #75】。  
- Morgan Stanley 分析師 Brian Nowak 強調，市場低估了 Meta 在 AI 方面的巨額支出，預計 2027‑2028 年的 **3800 億美元** 資本支出將帶來 **每股盈餘 1 至 3 美元** 的增幅，並指出若 Meta AI 搜尋工具能保有 10% 的每日查詢變現，年營收有望超過 **100億美元**，同時公司已推出分層訂閱方案以追求高毛利收入【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 基於上述 AI 投資與成長潛力，Morgan Stanley 重新給予 Meta **775 美元** 的目標股價，將其列為「永續最佳」的 mega‑cap 股票之一【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。

records.answer:

- 此外，Musk 最近在對 OpenAI 的訴訟中被陪審團全票駁回，原告要求的 1,500 億美元（$150 billion） 損害賠償未獲支持，判決亦涉及 Microsoft 的相關索賠被認定超過時效【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #1】。此法律敗訴亦提升了外界對 Musk 個人及其旗下企業的關注度。

- **地理佈局**：IREN 正在歐洲（西班牙）與亞太地區（澳洲）擴展資料中心，新增 **490 MW** 的西班牙電力資源，並持續在英國、加拿大與美國等地建置大型 GPU 設備【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. 綜合來看，Tesla 的汽車毛利率在較長期間內呈上升趨勢，顯示營運效率提升；但受整體「Magnificent Seven」股價下跌的市場情緒影響，Tesla 股價近期仍面臨下行壓力。

records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 直接嵌入 Microsoft 365 商務版雲端服務，讓 AI 功能成為提升每位使用者收入（Revenue‑per‑user）與使用率的關鍵驅動力【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  

- Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品與雲端服務現在包含 Microsoft 365 Copilot，作為 AI‑powered 平台的一環，與 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security 等服務共同提供 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與代理情境，涵蓋溝通、協作、分析、資安與合規等領域【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  
- 2026 年第一季（截至 2026‑03‑31）Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端營收成長 19%，其中每位使用者收入的提升主要由 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 推動【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 同期 Microsoft 365 Commercial 總營收增加 17%（+ 37 億美元（$3.7 billion）），顯示 Copilot 的加入與其他 AI 功能共同帶動了整體營收成長【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 為支援 Copilot 座位與使用量的 AI 基礎建設，成本項目（Cost of revenue）上升了 **6.8 億美元（$680 million）**，反映在 AI 基礎設施投資上【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 同時，營運費用因持續投入研發計算容量、AI 人才以及 Copilot 相關廣告支出，增加了 **7.95 億美元（$795 million）**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  

因此，Microsoft 透過將 Copilot 融入 Microsoft 365 商務版雲端服務、擴充 AI 功能與場景、提升每位使用者的收入貢獻，同時加大 AI 基礎設施與研發投入，將 Copilot 作為產品策略的核心組件。

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在大幅提升對 AWS 基礎設施與人工智慧（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資，透過持續增加技術與基礎設施支出、簽署百億美元級別的長期合約，以及直接投入股權資金，以確保 AWS 晶片需求並推動 AI 工作負載的成長【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #97】。

1. **技術與基礎設施支出持續上升**  
   - 2026 年第二季及截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的六個月，技術與基礎設施成本較去年同期增加 **4.27 億美元（$427 million）**，主要因基礎設施（包括伺服器、網路設備與資料中心折舊）支出上升【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79】。  
   - 公司預期未來「**持續增加**」技術與基礎設施支出，以支援人工智慧與機器學習計畫，雖然短期會壓縮自由現金流，但有助於長期成長【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #97】。

2. **與 OpenAI 的多年度合作與資本投入**  
   - 2026 年第一季，AWS 與 OpenAI 擴大原有 **380 億美元（$38.0 billion）** 的多年度承諾，額外增加 **1,000 億美元（$100.0 billion）**（為期 8 年），其中包括 AWS 晶片的執行義務【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #35】。  
   - Amazon 已投資 **150 億美元（$15.0 billion）** 於 OpenAI Series C 優先股，並根據「承諾書」再承諾購買 **350 億美元（$35.0 billion）** 的股份；截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，已投入 **137 億美元（$13.7 billion）**（第二季）以及在資產負債表上列示 **287 億美元（$28.7 billion）** 的投資金額【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。  

3. **與 Anthropic 的戰略合作與資本配置**  
   - 2026 年第二季，AWS 與 Anthropic 擴大既有多年度合作，額外承諾 **超過 1,000 億美元（$100.0 billion）**（為期 10 年），同樣涵蓋 AWS 晶片的執行義務【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #35】。  
   - Amazon 於 2026 年 3 月底後投資 **50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 於 Anthropic 非投票優先股，並設立最高 **200 億美元（$20.0 billion）** 的融資設施，允許 Anthropic 在達成特定計算里程碑後提取資金；同時保留 **最高 50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 的未來股權投資選項【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38】。  

4. **長期合約與未來收入來源**

[AMZN 10-Q period 202606] [section: Technology and Infrastructure] Technology and Infrastructure

Technology and infrastructure costs include payroll and related expenses for employees involved in the research and development of new and existing products and services, development, design, and maintenance of our stores, curation and display of products and services made available in our online stores, and infrastructure costs. Infrastructure costs include servers, networking equipment, and data center related depreciation and amortization, rent, utilities, and other expenses necessary to support AWS and other Amazon businesses. Collectively, these costs reflect the investments we make in order to offer a wide variety of products and services to our customers, including expenditures related to initiatives to build and deploy innovative and efficient software and electronic devices and the development of a satellite network for global broadband service and autonomous vehicles for ride-hailing services. We seek to invest efficiently in numerous areas of technology and infrastructure so we may continue to enhance the customer experience and improve our process efficiency through rapid technology developments, while operating at an ever increasing scale. Our technology and infrastructure investment and capital spending projects often support a variety of product and service offerings due to geographic expansion and the cross-functionality of our systems and operations. We expect spending in technology and infrastructure to increase over time as we continue to add infrastructure and employees, including to support our artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives. These costs are allocated to segments based on usage. The increase in technology and infrastructure costs in Q2 2026 and for the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared to the comparable prior year periods, is primarily due to an increase in spending on infrastructure, including depreciation and amortization. Changes in foreign exchange rates did not significantly impact technology and infrastructure costs for Q2 2026, but increased technology and infrastructure costs by $427 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Technology and infrastructure costs in Q2 2026 include net unrealized gains for energy contracts that are subject to derivative accounting, primarily related to AWS. records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商平台面臨多項反壟斷與監管風險，主要包括政府與監管機構的調查、訴訟，以及可能涉及數十億美元的損害賠償要求。  

1. **競爭與消費者保護調查**：美國、加拿大、英國等地的政府機關與反托拉斯機構正對 Amazon 的商店營運、履行網路、Prime 服務以及 AWS 雲端服務提出競爭相關或消費者保護的調查，Amazon 表示將積極抗辯。 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81]、[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124]、[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #125]  

2. **具體反壟斷訴訟**：自 2020 年以來，私營原告、州檢察長與聯邦貿易委員會在美國、加拿大與英國提出多起訴訟，指控 Amazon 價格固定、濫用支配地位、試圖壟斷線上超市、市場服務與中介服務，並指控其在定價政策、Featured Offers 選擇、賣家數據使用、廣告做法、Prime 結構以及自有商品推廣上存在不公平行為。這些訴訟要求**數十億美元**的損害賠償、三倍賠償、懲罰性賠償、禁令、結構性救濟與民事罰金。 [AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45]  

3. **稅務與其他監管挑戰**：Amazon 亦在意大利面臨稅務挑戰，並因其在全球範圍內的業務擴張而受到日益增多的監管審查，包括資料隱私、資料使用與資料保護等方面的合規風險。 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124]、[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #125]  

4. **潛在的財務與營運衝擊**：上述不利的監管決策、法律判決或執行行動可能導致 Amazon 承擔巨額罰款、增加合規成本、限制產品與服務的供應，甚至迫使其改變業務慣例，對公司成長與盈利產生實質負面影響。 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81]

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 把 Gemini AI 直接嵌入搜尋功能，並透過多項產品與服務擴散到整個生態系。  

- 在搜尋方面，Google 以 **AI Overviews** 與 **AI Mode** 讓使用者可以以自然語言提問，並利用 Gemini 的先進推理與多模態能力產生即時、具互動性的回應，這些功能已經在 Search 中上線【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- Gemini 3 作為最新的 AI 模型，已被整合進 Search 以及全新推出的 **Gemini App**，讓搜尋結果更具生成式與互動性，同時支援視覺化與多媒體查詢【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- 在 Google Workspace（Gmail、Docs、Sheets、Drive、Calendar、Meet）中，Gemini 以 **Gemini for Google Workspace** 形態嵌入，協助使用者撰寫、整理、視覺化內容並加速工作流程【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- 企業客戶則可透過 **Gemini Enterprise** 在 Google Cloud 平台上使用，提供安全的 AI 代理人與聊天介面，將 Gemini 的生成式與推理能力帶入企業內部的各種應用【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- 除了上述核心產品，Alphabet 表示其 15 個擁有超過半億使用者的產品（包括 YouTube、Google Play、Pixel 裝置等）皆已使用 Gemini 模型，形成跨產品的 AI 生態鏈【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

總結來說，Google 透過在搜尋介面加入 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode、在 Workspace 中部署 Gemini for Workspace、在雲端服務提供 Gemini Enterprise，並將 Gemini 模型廣泛應用於所有主要產品，實現了 Gemini AI 在搜尋與整個產品生態系的深度整合。

records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋透過引入大型語言模型與多模態技術，將傳統的藍連結結果演變成可直接產出即時、深入回應的 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，以因應生成式 AI 對搜尋行為的衝擊【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196】【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。

- 早期的 Google Search 只提供網頁連結，隨著「大型語言模型」的發展，Alphabet 能讓使用者以更自然的語句提出問題，並利用 Gemini 的推理與多模態能力提升答案品質【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- AI Overviews 讓使用者「問任何事」時，系統即在搜尋結果頁面上直接呈現簡潔、聚合的回應，降低需要點擊多個連結的需求【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- AI Mode 則允許使用者提出更「細緻、具多步驟」的問題，系統會利用 Gemini 的進階推理與多模態功能，提供更深入的答案，彌補傳統搜尋在處理複雜查詢時的限制【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- 這兩項功能是 Alphabet 「將 AI 融入產品與服務」的具體表現，旨在先提升使用者體驗，再逐步探索營收模式，同時因應其他 AI 供應商的競爭壓力【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196】。  

因此，Google 搜尋的演變是從單純的關鍵字匹配，轉向以生成式 AI 為核心的即時答案與多步驟對話功能，以保持在 AI 時代的競爭優勢。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是以 AI 與 Reality Labs 為核心，推動元宇宙（metaverse）與新平台的發展，同時持續大規模投入伺服器、資料中心、VR/AR 硬體與相關基礎建設，以建立下一代的計算與互動環境【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】。

**願景與策略**  
- META 明確表示，未來將持續「開發與訓練 AI 模型」並「增加在新平台與技術（包括 VR、Horizon 與可穿戴裝置）的投資」​【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】。  
- 公司將元宇宙描述為「下一階段的社交科技」；自 2021 年起，META 轉向以 AI、可穿戴裝置與裝置創新來實現此願景，並預期此項計畫將是「複雜、持續演變且長期」的努力，需要新興技術研發、基礎設施投資、隱私與安全措施，以及與其他公司、開發者與合作夥伴的協作【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  
- META 亦承認 Reality Labs 目前產生的收入有限，且已大幅壓縮 2025 年整體營運利潤約 191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion），預期 2026 年的營運虧損將與 2025 年相似，顯示公司願意在短期內承受財務壓力以追求長期目標【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】。

**投資方向與資本支出**  
- 2025 年，META 在「購置不動產與設備」上花費 696.9 億美元（$69.69 billion），主要用於伺服器、資料中心與網路基礎建設；同時投入 183.3 億美元（$18.33 billion） 於非上市股權投資，及 100.5 億美元（$10.05 billion） 的可交易證券淨購買【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #219】。  
- 公司預計 2026 年的資本支出將介於 1,150 億美元（$115 billion） 至 1,350 億美元（$135 billion），以支援 AI 相關工作與核心業務【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #219】。  
- 在 Reality Labs 的營運費用分配上，2026 年預計約 70% 用於可穿戴裝置（wearables）計畫，剩餘 30% 用於 VR 與 Horizon 相關項目【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
- 非上市股權投資方面，META 持有的主要投資包括 2025 年完成的 Scale AI 投資 138 億美元（$13.80 billion） 以及截至 2025 年底的 Jio Platforms 投資 58.2 億美元（$5.82 billion），這些投資屬於「測量替代」類別【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #266】。  

**產品與研發重點**  
- 現行 VR 產品包括 Meta Quest 系列與 Meta Horizon Store，並已加入「透視」功能以提升沉浸感【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- 可穿戴與 AR 方面，META 推出 AI 眼鏡（Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta），2024 年展示 Orion 原型 AR 眼鏡，2025 年推出結合顯示與 AI 的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 以及利用肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- 這些硬體與軟體專案同時包含短期上市產品與長期研發計畫，顯示 META 正在同時布局即時營收與未來技術基礎【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。

**外部分析師觀點（補充投資方向）**  
- 摩根士丹利分析師指出，META 正在進行「大規模 AI 支出」，預計 2027‑2028 年的資本支出將達 3,800 億美元（$380 billion），並認為此投資有望在 2028 年為每股盈餘貢獻 $1‑$3【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 分析師亦提到，META 正在開發整合於 Meta AI 的搜尋功能，若能吸引 10% 的每日查詢量（約 10 億（1 billion） 使用者），預計可產生超過 100 億美元（$10 billion） 的年度營收；此外，公司已開始推出分層訂閱方案，以追求高毛利的收入來源【META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要透過在其「Family of Apps」中投放廣告獲利，廣告收入是以「每則廣告的平均價格」＝廣告總收入 ÷ 投放次數來計算，且廣告展示量與價格會因不同產品（如 Feed、Stories、Reels）以及公司調整廣告頻率的策略而上下波動；同時，Meta AI 作為跨平台的智慧助理，嵌入所有 App，負責提升內容排序、廣告工具、生成式 AI 體驗以及產品開發效率等多項功能【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。

- **廣告獲利模式**  
  - Meta 以「每則廣告的平均價格」作為衡量指標，計算方式為「總廣告收入除以廣告投放次數」，此價格代表行銷人員為每則廣告（不論是曝光或行動目標）所支付的平均金額【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  
  - 廣告展示量會因產品類別不同而有所差異，例如影片與 Reels 的變現率目前尚未與 Feed 或 Stories 同步，且公司會定期「增加或減少廣告的數量或頻率」以配合產品與變現策略【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  
  - 2026 年第一季的總收入為 **563.1 億美元（$56.31 billion）**，較 2025 年第一季增長 **33%**，主要來自廣告收入的提升；同期廣告曝光量上升 **19%**，平均每則廣告價格上升 **12%**，顯示廣告單價與投放量均在成長【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #56】。

- **Meta AI 在 App 中的角色**  
  - Meta AI 是一個跨應用的智慧助理，除了在獨立 App、AI 眼鏡與網頁上提供服務外，也嵌入 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp 等所有主要應用中【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
  - AI 投資支援的功能包括：  
    1. **內容排序系統**：協助決定在各 App 中顯示哪些貼文或影片【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
    2. **發現引擎**：推薦相關內容給使用者，提升使用者黏著度【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
    3. **廣告工具**：為廣告主提供更精準的受眾定位與投放效能【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
    4. **生成式 AI 體驗**：開發新型態的 AI 生成內容與互動功能【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
    5. **產品開發效率**：利用 AI 讓內部開發流程更高效、提升創新速度【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
  - 在 Reality Labs（RL）部門，Meta AI 也整合於 AI 眼鏡（如 Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta）與相關穿戴裝置，提供語音與手勢交互功能【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

總結來說，Meta 透過廣告展示量與每則廣告的平均價格來創造主要營收，同時以 Meta AI 作為全平台的智慧層，支援內容排序、廣告效能、生成式體驗與內部開發，進一步增強其廣告生態系與使用者體驗【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

records.answer:
Tesla 把全自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，主要是透過自家 AI 演算法、專屬推論晶片、全車軟體整合與 OTA 更新，讓每台車皆具備未來自動駕駛與 Robotaxi 服務的基礎，並以此打造以 AI、軟體與車隊營運為核心的服務導向商業模式【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。

1. **自有 AI 與推論晶片**：Tesla 使用視覺為主的技術、系統與軟體來訓練人工神經網路，並由自家設計的推論晶片加速運算，這使得其自動駕駛演算法在效能與成本上具備獨特優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  

2. **全車軟體與 OTA 更新**：所有交付的車輛皆內建可透過 OTA（over‑the‑air）方式持續升級的軟體，讓 FSD 功能不斷進化且可即時提供新功能，提升使用者體驗並保持技術領先【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  

3. **與 Robotaxi 服務的結合**：2025 年 6 月推出的 Robotaxi 服務以 Model Y 為平台，未來將納入專為自動駕駛設計的 Cybercab，透過 FSD（Supervised）訂閱與車隊營運，將自動駕駛技術轉化為可產生軟體與車隊利潤的服務模式，形成與傳統叫車平台的明顯差異【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  

4. **AI 驅動的競爭定位**：Tesla 明確指出其 AI 與自動駕駛技術是與其他 AI 與機器人領域競爭者的主要區隔，並以此作為在 Robotaxi 市場與傳統叫車服務競爭的關鍵優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #44】。  

5. **整合硬體與軟體的垂直整合模式**：Tesla 透過垂直整合的商業模式，從車輛設計、電池與動力傳動系統到軟體平台全程自行開發，確保 FSD 功能與車輛硬體高度匹配，進一步鞏固其在自動駕駛領域的差異化【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  

綜合以上，Tesla 以自研 AI 演算法與硬體、持續 OTA 軟體升級、與 Robotaxi 服務的深度結合，以及完整的垂直整合供應鏈，將 FSD/Autopilot 打造成與競爭對手明顯區隔的核心競爭力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #44】。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. We believe that this mission, along with our engineering expertise, advancements in real-world AI, vertically integrated business model, and focus on user experience differentiate us from other companies. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. The automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacturing, sales and leasing of high-performance fully electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes sales, leasing, and financing of energy generation and storage products, services related to such products and sales of energy generation incentives. Our Products and Services

Automotive

We currently manufacture five different consumer vehicles – the Model 3, Y, S, X and Cybertruck. Model 3 is a four-door mid-size sedan that we designed for manufacturability with a base price for mass-market appeal. Model Y is a compact sport utility vehicle (“SUV”) built on the Model 3 platform with seating for up to seven adults. Model S is a four-door full-size sedan and Model X is a mid-size SUV with seating for up to seven adults. Model S and Model X feature the highest performance characteristics and longest ranges that we offer in a sedan and SUV, respectively. The Cybertruck is a full-size electric pickup truck with a stainless steel exterior that has the utility and strength of a truck while featuring the speed of a sports car. In 2022, we also began early production and deliveries of a commercial electric vehicle, the Tesla Semi.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] As we seek to become a top provider of autonomous solutions, we also face competition in the fields of AI and robotics. We expect our Robotaxi service to compete in this developing market, along with traditional ride-hailing and taxi services, through continued progress on our FSD (Supervised) and neural network capabilities, Supercharger network and infotainment offerings. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Systems

The market for energy storage products and services is also highly competitive, and both established and emerging companies have introduced products and services that are similar to our product portfolio or that are alternatives to the elements of our systems or software service offerings. We compete with these companies based on price, energy density, efficiency, optimization and performance. We believe that the specifications and features of our products, our strong brand and the modular, scalable nature of our energy storage products give us a competitive advantage in our markets. 10


Energy Generation Systems

The primary competitors to our energy generation business are the traditional local utility companies that supply energy to our potential customers. We compete with these traditional utility companies primarily based on price and the ease by which customers can switch to electricity generated by our energy generation systems. We also compete with solar energy companies that provide products and services similar to ours. Many solar energy companies only install solar energy systems, while others only provide financing for these installations. We believe we have a significant expansion opportunity with our offerings, including in terms of the aesthetics, superior performance and ease of installation and integration with Powerwall of our solar panels, and that the environment is increasingly conducive to the adoption of renewable energy systems. Intellectual Property

We place a strong emphasis on our innovative approach and proprietary designs which bring intrinsic value and uniqueness to our product portfolio. As part of our business, we seek to protect the underlying intellectual property rights of these innovations and designs such as with respect to patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, confidential information and other measures, including through employee and third-party nondisclosure agreements and other contractual arrangements. For example, we place a high priority on obtaining patents to provide the broadest and strongest possible protection to enable our freedom to operate our innovations and designs across all of our products and technologies as well as to protect and defend our product portfolio. We have also adopted a patent policy in which we irrevocably pledged that we will not initiate a lawsuit against any party for infringing our patents through activity relating to electric vehicles or related equipment for so long as such party is acting in good faith. We made this pledge in order to encourage the advancement of a common, rapidly-evolving platform for electric vehicles, thereby benefiting ourselves, other companies making electric vehicles and the world. Human Capital Resources 

Tesla’s ability to attract, develop and retain a talented workforce is a competitive advantage. As of December 31, 2025, our employee headcount worldwide was 134,785.

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨來自傳統內燃機車廠與新進電動與混合動力車廠的激烈且多元的競爭態勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43】。  

- 依照車型與動力技術分類，Cybertruck 直接與其他皮卡車競爭；Model S 與 Model X 主要與高階轎車及高階 SUV 競爭；Model 3 與 Model Y 則與小型至中型轎車及緊湊型 SUV 競爭【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43】。  
- 這些競爭產品大多為已建立的汽車製造商所推出的內燃機車型，且許多既有與新興的汽車公司已宣布或正計畫進入電動車或其他替代燃料車市場【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43】。  
- 目前在美國、中國與歐洲等主要市場，已有多家大型汽車製造商提供電動車，同時亦有多家廠商開發混合動力（含插電式）車型【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43】。

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 把能源生成與儲能業務定位為支援公司清潔能源與 AI 計算基礎設施的關鍵事業之一，與汽車事業相互補強並共享技術平台【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

- **雙段式事業結構**：公司將營運分為「汽車」與「能源生成與儲能」兩大部門，後者涵蓋住宅、商業與工業客戶的太陽能板、Solar Roof、Powerwall、Megapack 等產品與相關服務【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **技術共享與模組化設計**：在 2025 年，Tesla 開發了自有的鋰離子電池芯，並採用模組化電池系統設計，以提升能源儲存產品的製造彈性與產能，同時利用來自汽車的元件級技術【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
- **電力電子與軟體平台**：公司憑藉在電力電子領域的專長，使電池系統能與電網快速互動；此外，透過 Powerhub（分散式能源資源平台）與 Autobidder（Megapack 調度平台）等軟體，遠端控制與即時調度能源儲存設備【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
- **太陽能產品與整合**：2025 年開始製造新型住宅翻新太陽能板，2026 年初已交付；同時持續生產 Solar Roof，並設計與 Powerwall 完全整合的系統，提升能源生成與儲能的協同效應【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
- **基礎建設與 AI 計算**：為支撐清潔能源與自動駕駛等長期願景，Tesla 投資建置額外的計算硬體與 AI 訓練叢集（Cortex、Cortex 2），並與 Samsung 合作製造先進 AI 推論與訓練晶片，這些基礎設施同時服務於能源儲存與電動車領域【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  

綜合以上，能源生成與儲能不僅是獨立的營收來源，更是透過共享電池、電力電子、軟體與 AI 計算資源，與汽車事業形成互補，成為 Tesla 推動「清潔能源」與「自動駕駛」雙重長期願景的核心平台之一。

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年的 10‑K 中說明，它在智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板等主要產品線僅佔「少數」市場份額，且面臨高度激烈且持續加劇的競爭壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。

**競爭壓力的具體描述**  
- 市場「高度競爭」且充斥「激進的價格競爭」與「毛利率下行壓力」；產品生命週期短、標準快速演變，競爭者不斷推出新產品【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #21】。  
- 競爭者擁有「龐大的技術、行銷、分銷」資源，且常以「低成本結構」與「極低甚至虧損的價格」來爭奪市場【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #21】。  
- 競爭者會「模仿 Apple 的產品功能與應用」以及「侵害其智慧財產權」，使 Apple 必須持續保護與執行 IP 權利【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- Apple 必須不斷「及時推出創新新產品、服務與技術」才能在這些市場中保持競爭力，因為競爭者會「模仿 Apple 的整合方案」或合作提供整合解決方案【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

**市佔地位的說明**  
- Apple 在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板以及可穿戴裝置市場的「市場佔有率屬於少數」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

總結來說，Apple 自己在 10‑K 中承認，它在上述三大硬體市場的份額並不佔主導，且必須面對價格、產品創新、模仿與智慧財產權保護等多層面的激烈競爭。

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] Europe includes European countries, as well as India, the Middle East and Africa. Greater China includes China mainland, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Markets and Distribution

The Company’s customers are primarily in the consumer, small and mid-sized business, education, enterprise and government markets. The Company sells its products and resells third-party products in most of its major markets directly to customers through its retail and online stores and its direct sales force. The Company sells its services in the same markets through its various service platforms. The Company also employs a variety of indirect distribution channels, such as third-party cellular network carriers and other resellers, for the sale of its products and certain of its services. During 2025, the Company’s net sales through its direct and indirect distribution channels accounted for 40% and 60%, respectively, of total net sales. Competition

The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive and are characterized by aggressive price competition, downward pressure on gross margins, continual improvement in product performance, and price sensitivity on the part of consumers and businesses. The markets in which the Company competes are further defined by frequent introduction of new products and services, short product life cycles, evolving industry standards, and rapid adoption of technological advancements by competitors. Many of the Company’s competitors seek to compete primarily through aggressive pricing and very low cost structures, and by imitating the Company’s products and infringing on its intellectual property. Apple Inc. | 2025 Form 10-K | 2

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design and technology innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, corporate reputation, and the ability to effectively protect and enforce the Company’s intellectual property rights. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company’s products and services face substantial competition from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, the Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products to offer more competitive solutions. The Company also expects competition to intensify as competitors imitate the Company’s approach to providing components seamlessly within their offerings or work collaboratively to offer integrated solutions. Some of the Company’s competitors have broad product lines, low-priced products, large installed bases of active devices, and large customer bases. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. agentic_sub_queries: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過 **App Store 這一唯一官方發佈渠道、平台抽成機制以及與硬體/服務的深度整合**，讓第三方開發者在 iOS、生態系統內部形成一定黏著度；同時，因 **全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的市場佔有率屬少數（minority market share）**，開發者相較於 Android、Windows 等平台的投入意願較低，這也限制了黏著度的提升【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。  

- **App Store 作為主要分銷管道**：Apple 透過 App Store 向開發者提供應用上架與銷售服務，並從應用與內建數位商品的銷售中抽取佣金；若開發者改用直接面向消費者的分銷模式，Apple 可能失去全部或部分佣金，對其營收、毛利與股價產生不利影響【AAPL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #60】。  
- **開發者支援取決於平台的感知利益**：開發者會根據平台的市場地位、預期營收、未來成長與開發成本來評估是否投入資源；Apple 必須讓開發者相信在 iOS 上的收益與成長潛力足以抵消其相對較小的市場規模【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。  
- **市場佔有率的影響**：因 Apple 在全球智慧手機、PC、平板與穿戴裝置的佔有率屬少數，開發者較傾向將資源投入 Android（市場佔有率較高）或 Windows（PC 市場較大）的平台，這直接削弱了 Apple 生態系的開發者黏著度【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。  
- **技術變化與內容供應**：Apple 的產品與作業系統變化快速，若第三方開發者無法跟上更新速度，應用可能無法利用新功能或出現錯誤，進一步影響使用者體驗與開發者的持續投入意願【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。  

綜合以上，Apple 主要依靠 **App Store 的獨占分銷與抽成、與硬體/服務的緊密整合** 來維持開發者黏著度；但 **市場佔有率較低與開發成本的考量** 使得相較於 Android、Windows 等平台，開發者的黏著度仍受到限制。

records.answer:

records.query: NVIDIA 這一季在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨狀況如何？跟去年同期相比有何變化？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 本季在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨為 **$0**，相較去年同期的 **46 億美元（$4.6 billion）** 完全消失，等於出貨額下降了約 **100%**【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47】。  

- 2027 財年第一季（截至 2026‑04‑26）報告稱「No shipments of Data Center Hopper products to China occurred during the quarter, compared with 46 億美元（$4.6 billion） in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026」【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47】。  
- 2026 財年第一季的 46 億美元（$4.6 billion） 代表去年同期（2025‑04‑27）對中國的資料中心產品（主要是 Hopper 系列）出貨金額【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47】。  
- 這一變化與美國政府對中國的晶片出口限制直接相關，因為公司已在多份報告中說明「我們已被實質性地排除在中國資料中心市場之外」以及相關的許可與關稅問題【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #84】【NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #28】。  

因此，2027 財年第一季 NVIDIA 在中國的資料中心晶片出貨從去年同期的 46 億美元跌至零，顯示出因出口管制而導致的全面停供。

[NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. Beginning in August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement. Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China. The license requires that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200 shipped under the new licensing program will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. In the event that we are able to sell licensed products into the China market, we may not be able to pass along all or any of the tariff to our customers, and may be subject to litigation, increased costs, and a harmed competitive position. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a data center system that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

[NVDA 10-Q period 202510] During the third quarter of fiscal year 2023, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. During the second quarter of fiscal year 2024, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. During the third quarter of fiscal year 2024, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. On April 9, 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these new requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. We have effectively been foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market will help our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a product that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

[TSLA 10-Q period 202603] [section: Overview] Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence into the real world, through products and services like FSD (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. As a result of rapidly evolving trade and fiscal policy and geopolitical conflicts, uncertainty in the automotive and energy markets continues, posing risks to our global supply chain and cost structure which could have a meaningfully adverse impact on demand for our products and our profitability. The current tariff regime will have a relatively larger impact on our energy generation and storage business compared to our automotive business. While we prepare for near-term challenges to our business under current policies, we are focused on long-term growth opportunities as we continue to make prudent investments. In 2026, we produced approximately 408 thousand consumer vehicles and delivered approximately 358 thousand consumer vehicles through the first quarter. We are focused on profitable growth, further improving and deploying our FSD (Supervised) capabilities, including future autonomous capabilities through our purpose-built Robotaxi product, Cybercab, advancing our battery and AI compute technologies, vertically integrating and localizing our supply chain, and expanding our global infrastructure. We have continued to expand and refine our Robotaxi service after its June 2025 launch, capitalizing on our AI investments and scalable mobility infrastructure to advance a service-driven business model. In 2026, we deployed 8.8 GWh of energy storage products through the first quarter.

While we prepare for near-term challenges to our business under current policies, we are focused on long-term growth opportunities as we continue to further vertically integrate and localize our supply chain and make prudent investments in infrastructure. In 2026, we produced approximately 860 thousand consumer vehicles and delivered approximately 838 thousand consumer vehicles through the second quarter. We are focused on profitable growth and scale, further improving and deploying our FSD (Supervised) capabilities, including future autonomous capabilities through our purpose-built Robotaxi product, Cybercab, advancing our battery and AI compute technologies and expanding our global infrastructure. [TSLA 10-K period 2025] As a result of rapidly evolving trade and fiscal policy, uncertainty in the automotive and energy markets continues, posing risks to our global supply chain and cost structure which could have a meaningfully adverse impact on demand for our products and our profitability. The current tariff regime will have a relatively larger impact on our energy generation and storage business compared to our automotive business. While we prepare for near-term challenges to our business under current policies, we are focused on long-term growth opportunities as we continue to make prudent investments. In 2025, we produced approximately 1.66 million consumer vehicles and delivered approximately 1.64 million consumer vehicles. We are focused on profitable growth via a differentiated and efficiently managed product portfolio that leverages our existing factories and production lines, further improving and deploying our FSD (Supervised) capabilities, including future autonomous capabilities through our purpose-built Robotaxi product, Cybercab, reducing costs, increasing vehicle production, utilized capacity and delivery capabilities, improving and developing our vehicles, battery and AI compute technologies, vertically integrating and localizing our supply chain, and expanding our global infrastructure, including our service and charging infrastructure. We have continued to expand and refine our Robotaxi service after its June 2025 launch, capitalizing on our AI investments and scalable mobility infrastructure to advance a service-driven business model. In 2025, we deployed 46.7 GWh of energy storage products.

[TSLA 10-Q period 202606] [section: Overview] We are focused on ramping the production, increasing the market penetration of our energy storage products and developing our solar manufacturing and battery technologies. During the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, we recognized total revenues of $28.24 billion and $50.62 billion, respectively, representing increases of $5.74 billion and $8.79 billion, respectively, compared to the same periods in the prior year. During the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, our net income attributable to common stockholders was $1.11 billion and $1.59 billion, respectively, representing a decrease of $58 million and an increase of $10 million, respectively, compared to the same periods in the prior year. We continue to ramp production and build and optimize our manufacturing capacity, expand our operations while focusing on further cost reductions and operational efficiencies, including through vertical integration of our battery and semiconductor supply chains, to enable increased deliveries and deployments of our products. We are also investing heavily in research and development to accelerate our AI, software and fleet-based profits for further revenue growth, which will negatively impact our profitability during this phase. We ended the second quarter of 2026 with $43.52 billion in cash and cash equivalents and short-term investments, representing a decrease of $535 million from the end of 2025. Our cash flows provided by operating activities were $8.63 billion during the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared to $4.70 billion during the same period ended June 30, 2025, representing an increase of $3.94 billion. Capital expenditures amounted to $8.28 billion during the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared to $3.89 billion during the same period ended June 30, 2025, representing an increase of $4.40 billion. Overall growth has allowed our business to generally fund itself.

records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟是透過在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 服務中加入 Microsoft 365 Copilot，並以 AI 基礎建設支援 Copilot 座位與使用量，將 AI 功能嵌入其生產力與協作平台【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。

- Microsoft 365 Copilot 被定位為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品與雲端服務的一部份，屬於 AI‑驅動的商務與生產力解決方案平台，會在通訊、協作、分析、安全、合規等多項功能中加入 AI 工具與代理情境【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  
- 為支援 Copilot 座位與使用量的成長，微軟在本期「成本 of revenue」上投入了 AI 基礎建設的資金，導致成本上升 12%（16 億美元（$1.6 billion））【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #74】；同樣的投資在三個月比較中亦被指出為「投資 AI 基礎建設以支援 Microsoft 365 Copilot 座位與使用量」【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 這些 AI 基礎建設的投入使得 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入增長 19%，其中部分動能來自 Microsoft 365 Copilot 帶來的每位使用者收入提升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 由於 AI 功能的加入，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的毛利率因效率提升而上升，毛利額增加 128 億美元（$12.8 billion）（18%）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #74】；全年毛利額亦因 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的成長而提升 166 億美元（$16.6 billion）（17%）【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #128】。  

總結來說，微軟透過在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品線中整合 Microsoft 365 Copilot，並在後端建置 AI 計算與資料基礎設施，使 AI 功能能在其生產力與協作服務中被使用，從而驅動收入與毛利的提升。

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜最近在人工智慧領域大幅投入資金，先以 150 億美元購買 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署長期合作協議，同時保留高達 350 億美元的後續購買承諾；此外，還對 Anthropic 設立最高 20 億美元的融資設施並持有額外的投資權益【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。

- **OpenAI 股權投資**：在 2026 年第一季，亞馬遜向 OpenAI 投入 **150 億美元** 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署一份「股權承諾信」(Letter Agreement)，約定在未來可再購買價值 **350 億美元** 的額外 Series C 優先股【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。  
- **已執行的後續投資**：2026 年第二季，亞馬遜已使用 **137 億美元** 完成部分承諾投資，累計在 2026 年 6 月 30 日的帳面上記錄 **287 億美元** 的投資金額【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。  
- **投資價值的帳面呈現**：截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，亞馬遜在非會計法下持有的私募股權（主要為 OpenAI 與 Anthropic）帳面價值為 **16.2 億美元**，而至 2026 年 6 月 30 日則升至 **122.3 億美元**【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。  
- **商業合作安排**：同時，亞馬遜與 OpenAI 簽署了以 AWS 雲端服務為核心的商業安排，包含使用 AWS 晶片提供 OpenAI 模型服務，並將相關服務在 AWS 平台上向客戶提供【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。  

- **Anthropic 相關投資**：亞馬遜亦在 2026 年第一季向 Anthropic 投入 **5.0 億美元** 的可轉換票據融資設施，該設施最高可提供 **20.0 億美元** 的資金，並保留未來可再投資 **5.0 億美元** 的選擇權；此外，2026 年 3 月底已投資 **5.0 億美元** 至 Anthropic 的非投票優先股【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38】。  

綜合以上，亞馬遜正透過大額股權投資、長期購買承諾、雲端服務合作以及對 Anthropic 的融資安排，積極在 AI 領域布局，主要合作夥伴為 **OpenAI**（以及同時持續投入的 **Anthropic**）。

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] [section: Understanding Alphabet’s Financial Results] As we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, and with enterprise AI solutions on our Google Cloud Platform, we may monetize differently than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings which could affect revenue growth rates and margin trends. When developing new products and services we generally focus first on user experience and then on monetization. At the same time, we face increasing competition, including from other developers and providers of AI products and services, which may affect our revenues. Increasing Revenues Beyond Advertising: Revenues from cloud, consumer subscriptions, platforms, and devices, which may have differing characteristics than our advertising revenues, have grown over time. Certain of these revenues have been growing at a rate higher than our advertising revenues, becoming a larger percentage of our consolidated revenues, and we expect this trend to continue. The margins on these revenues vary significantly and are generally lower than the margins on our advertising revenues. Increased Investment in Technical Infrastructure: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally. We invested heavily in capital expenditures in 2025 and in 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers. The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings. While our technical infrastructure costs increase, we expect to continue to drive efficiencies in our data centers, for example, through the design of our AI models and our TPU and GPU-based technical infrastructure. Continued Investment in Intellectual Property through R&D and Acquisitions: We continue to make significant research and development investments in areas of strategic focus as we seek to develop new, innovative offerings, and improve our existing offerings across our businesses. records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正在把 VR 眼鏡與 AI 結合，朝「沉浸式 AR/VR 體驗」與「個人化 AI 助理」兩大方向發展，期望打造下一代的元宇宙平台與超級智慧應用。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25][META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22]

- **VR 硬體與內容**：Meta 以 Meta Quest 系列為核心，透過 Meta Horizon Store 提供遊戲、健身、娛樂等社交內容，並加入「passthrough」技術讓使用者在虛擬與現實之間保持連結。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- **AR/AI 眼鏡**：現有的 Ray‑Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 眼鏡內建 Meta AI，2024 推出 Orion 原型（真實 AR 眼鏡，具業界領先的視野與佩戴舒適度），2025 再推出結合顯示屏的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，並配合使用肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band 手環。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- **AI 平台與模型**：Meta 投資於生成式 AI 與「超級智慧」模型，這些 AI 用於內容排序、廣告工具、發現引擎，以及在所有應用（包括 AI 眼鏡與獨立 Meta AI App）中提供對話式助理功能。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22][META_10K_2025.html, chunk #29]  
- **商業結構**：VR/AR 硬體與相關軟體屬於 Reality Labs（RL）事業部，與以廣告為主的 Family of Apps（FoA）分開營運，RL 主要靠 FoA 產生的利潤來支撐其長期研發投入。[META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1]  
- **風險與挑戰**：Meta 承認 Reality Labs 的策略可能失敗，原因包括元宇宙市場接受度不確定、硬體與第三方平台的相容性問題、以及與競爭對手在消費硬體與 AR/VR 技術上的較量，這些因素可能影響其 VR/AI 產品的商業化進度。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165][META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56]  

綜合以上，Meta 的 VR 眼鏡與 AI 發展路線是以「沉浸式、跨設備的社交與工作平台」為核心，透過硬體（Quest、AR 眼鏡）與軟體（生成式 AI、Meta AI 助理）雙向升級，同時必須克服市場接受度與技術整合的重大風險。

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. In 2025, we introduced Meta Ray-Ban Display, which combines our AI glasses with an integrated display built into the lens. It comes with the Meta Neural Band, which is a wrist-worn wearable device that uses electromyography to let people control their AI glasses using neuromuscular signals. In general, our Reality Labs efforts include shorter-term projects developing specific products and services to go to market, as well as longer-term research and development projects.

records.query: 特斯拉的自動駕駛跟別家車廠比，厲害在哪裡？
records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛優勢在於其全車系皆內建以視覺為主的 AI 技術、自行設計的推論晶片、以及透過 OTA（Over‑the‑Air）軟體更新持續提升功能，讓每輛車都具備未來自動駕駛的基礎，並藉由龐大的實車資料庫加速 AI 訓練，形成與其他車廠不同的競爭力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。

- **視覺與 AI 為核心**：特斯拉使用基於影像的感測與系統軟體，訓練自家人工神經網路，並以自家設計的推論晶片加速運算，這套完整的 AI 堆疊在公司內部開發完成，與外部供應商的解決方案形成差異【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **全車系設計為自動駕駛**：公司聲稱「每一輛交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為自動駕駛設計」，意味著硬體平台與軟體架構從一開始就為未來的全自動駕駛做準備，與仍需在後裝或額外套件上加裝感測器的競爭對手形成對照【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **OTA 軟體持續升級**：特斯拉能透過 OTA 方式遠端更新車輛軟體，快速部署新功能與安全改進，讓自動駕駛功能在不更換硬體的情況下持續進化，這在傳統車廠的 OTA 能力較為有限的情況下是一大優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **龐大實車資料與 AI 迴路**：公司強調「將 AI 資料學習成果應用於機器人（如 Optimus）」，顯示其在自動駕駛與機器人領域的資料循環利用，進一步提升演算法效能，這種資料規模與跨產品線的應用是其他車廠較難複製的【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **垂直整合與服務導向**：特斯拉的商業模式不僅賣車，還包括 FSD（Supervised）訂閱、Robotaxi 服務等軟體與服務收入，透過 AI、軟體與車隊營運的結合，打造以 AI 為核心的服務驅動營收模型，這在以硬體銷售為主的傳統車廠中較為少見【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  

總結來說，特斯拉在自動駕駛領域的「視覺 AI + 自研推論晶片 + OTA 持續升級 + 全車系自動駕駛設計 + 大規模實車資料」四大要素，使其在與其他汽車製造商的比較中具備明顯的技術與商業模式優勢。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. LONDON, June 12 (Reuters) - Hedge funds sold out of the biggest U.S. tech stocks, and some even added ‌bearish positions, according to data from a JPMorgan note late ‌Thursday, just before SpaceX was set to go public on Friday. Shares in the "Magnificent Seven" -- ​a group that includes some of the biggest tech names on Wall Street, namely
Nvidia
,
Apple
, Amazon.com, Alphabet, Meta,
Tesla
, and Microsoft, have all declined since last Friday. The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF, which tracks these ‌stocks closely, declined over 2.4% ⁠since June 5, with some analysts saying investors were clearing their decks in order to prepare for the ⁠debut of Elon Musk's Space X on Friday. SpaceX posted a net loss of $4.94 billion in 2025, but its landmark listing targets a valuation of $1.77 ​trillion ​in a record-setting IPO, which would ​make it the seventh-biggest publicly ‌traded U.S. company by market value.

- 在 FY2025 的合併損益表中，Meta 的淨收入列示為 604.58 億美元（$60,458 million），較前一年略有下降，但仍維持在高位【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #0】。
